Her long dark hair has an imperfect side part and falls loosely behind both shoulders, with a few fine strands across the forehead and cheek. Keep a petite light adult frame, moderately narrow relaxed shoulders, natural adult head-to-shoulder proportions, a gently defined waist and naturally full covered curves, without enlarging the ribcage, excessively narrowing the shoulders or making her look juvenile. The bag has a rounded bucket shape and a woven loop detail near its opening. A delicate small gold pendant necklace rests at the collarbones, and subtle slim bracelets and small rings catch tiny highlights. Use direct on-camera flash that illuminates the face, shoulders, arms and ivory fabric while leaving the sea and sky dramatically underexposed. Keep luminous but textured skin, a warm pink flush on the cheeks, realistic flash highlights and soft natural shadow transitions; no waxy smoothing or artificial cold-white skin. Behind her, a low dark horizon separates the almost black blue-gray sky and sea, a few tiny distant red lights remain unobtrusive, and a faint line of breaking surf crosses behind the hips. The ground is dark and minimally described. Vertical 9:16 framing from above the sunglasses to the upper thighs, with generous dark sky above the head and the complete visible hands and bag inside the frame. Reorganize the edge space naturally without stretching or enlarging the person. Preserve the upward gaze, relaxed arms, shoulder-bag support and spontaneous nighttime holiday mood. Use believable photographic perspective, fine low-light grain and lightly retouched skin microtexture. No text, signs, logos, watermark, borders, explicit sexual content or nudity. Generate the image now.
